title.zh: 将伊富高省 Asipulo 市镇 Camandag 描笼涯的 Hallap 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Camandag 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Haliap National High School - Camandag Annex in Barangay Camandag, Municipality of Asipulo, Province of Ifugao from the Hallap National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Camandag National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Camandag của Trường Trung học Haliap Quốc gia tại Barangay Camandag, Đô thị Asipulo, Tỉnh Ifugao khỏi Trường Trung học Hallap Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Camandag Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Camandag ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Haliap แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Camandag เทศบาล Asipulo จังหวัด Ifugao ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Hallap แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Camandag แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Camandag, Sekolah Menengah Haliap Nasional di Barangay Camandag, Kotamadya Asipulo, Provinsi Ifugao dari Sekolah Menengah Hallap Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Camandag Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Camandag, Sekolah Menengah Haliap Kebangsaan di Barangay Camandag, Perbandaran Asipulo, Wilayah Ifugao daripada Sekolah Menengah Hallap Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Camandag Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Haliap National High School - Camandag Annex in Barangay Camandag, Municipality of Asipulo, Province of Ifugao is hereby separated from the Haliap National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Camandag National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Haliap National High School - Camandag Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Camandag National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of Camandag National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of Haliap National High School - Camandag Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
